cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake at chest height; A habitat food lab with a small tea station and a bright reading panel above a drawer of spare filters — She draws the intact mesh filter out of a broken tea infuser to reuse it in a clean metal frame; A transparent observation bay beside an orbital hydrotherapy pool — She checks whether one fin has a worn hinge after swimming; a night observatory under an open dome — standing; a convention photo zone under ring lights — loops the strap of a camera over her head; her living room with a deep sofa — standing; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — kneeling on the ground; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — holds a white feather fan upright at chest height; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — standing; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — perched on a ledge or edge; a bridal room — holds a smartphone up at arm's length to take a selfie; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — standing close to a high shelf or line
